name: gaitai-ask-worker
description: Ask GaitAI — the hosted half of the movement-intelligence guide, as a Cloudflare Worker: canonical-record validation, the grounding prompt, one call to Cloudflare Workers AI through the AI binding, and sanitisation.

scripts.bench:serve: npm run corpus && wrangler dev -c wrangler.bench.jsonc --port 8788 --ip 127.0.0.1
scripts.check: npm run corpus && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir dist
scripts.deploy: npm run corpus && vitest run && wrangler deploy
